raw_text: Turkey's President Erdogan used the OIC platform to push for collective Islamic action on Kashmir, drawing sharp rebuke from India. Analysts note the campaign was pre-coordinated with Pakistani diplomatic channels and amplified through a network of social media accounts across multiple languages. India described the remarks as interference in internal affairs.
clean_text: Al Jazeera reports Erdogan's OIC Kashmir push was pre-coordinated with Pakistani diplomatic channels. India describes remarks as interference in internal affairs.
